name: @pipeworx/mcp-openf1

tools.name: get_meetings
tools.description: List Formula 1 meetings (Grand Prix weekends). Live race data source. Filter by year and/or country. Returns meeting_key, official name, country, circuit, location, date.

tools.name: get_sessions
tools.description: List F1 sessions (a Race, Qualifying, or Practice within a Grand Prix weekend). Use to find the session_key needed for drivers/laps. Filter by year, country, session_name ("Race","Qualifying","Practice 1"), or meeting_key.

meeting_key.description: Restrict to one Grand Prix weekend (from get_meetings).

tools.name: get_drivers
tools.description: List F1 drivers entered in a session (live race data): number, full name, 3-letter acronym, team, team colour, country, headshot. session_key="latest" for the most recent / ongoing session.

session_key.description: Session key, or 'latest' for the most recent session. Default 'latest'.

driver_number.description: Restrict to a single driver, e.g. 1, 44.

tools.name: get_laps
tools.description: Lap times / telemetry for an F1 session: per-lap duration, sector times, speed-trap, pit-out flag. Live race data. session_key="latest" for the most recent / ongoing session. Optionally filter by driver_number or lap_number.

session_key.description: Session key, or 'latest' for the most recent session. Required.

driver_number.description: Restrict to a single driver, e.g. 1, 44.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-openf1 forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the openf1 pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
